    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {

        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "Notebook Web App\n        │\n        ▼\nNotebook CR\n        │\n        ▼\nNotebook Controller\n        │\n        ├── StatefulSet\n        │       ↓\n        │      Pod\n        │\n        └── Service\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Pod 中真正运行的是 Jupyter Server、code-server 或 RStudio Server。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Workspace Volume、Data Volumes、GPU、Shared Memory 等页面配置，最终也都会转换成 Notebook CR 中相应的 Pod 配置。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "所以 Kubeflow Notebook 本身并没有重新实现一套计算和存储机制。它主要做的是在 Kubernetes 之上提供一套面向数据科学和机器学习开发场景的 Notebook Server 管理方式。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "再看 Notebook 的创建、启停、存储和访问路由就会清楚很多。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "参考资料",
      children: "参考资料"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: _jsx(_components.a, {

          children: "Kubeflow Notebooks 概览"
        })
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: _jsx(_components.a, {
          href: "https://www.kubeflow.org/docs/components/notebooks/quickstart-guide/",

        })
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: _jsx(_components.a, {

      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
}
